ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High white-to-black ratio estimated at approximately 4:1 across the visible surface, dominated by high-intensity white pixels in the center of the lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white regions occupy ~75% of the surface area. A high-contrast black vertical band is centered at the notch/peduncle interface. Dense black mottling is present along the distal trailing edges and tips. Symmetrical tan/ochre-colored intensity clusters are visible in the lower-medial sections of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a sharp interior angle estimated between 60-70 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular boundary featuring micro-serrations with pixel-amplitudes of 2-5 units; higher frequency of jagged peaks is localized at the distal lobe tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve along the outer margins transitioning to a concave sweep toward the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple small, low-intensity circular point-clusters (black on white) distributed across the interior of both lobes, notably on the left-side (viewer's left) white field.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent yellowish-tan pigmentation concentrated at the basal and medial sections of the ventral white surface.
